//: The workflow's harness contract in the SETTINGS-JSON SHAPE, which is what this file is named for: it holds nothing backend-specific. claude.kv points at it BY CONSTRUCTION (the note at its profile= key), and codex.hooks.json carries the same two workflow-owned hook commands verbatim in codex's own shape — a per-backend copy would project ONE contract into N files, so 30-closure compares the copies that exist and a split is licensed only by a real divergence, named. The enforcement anchor: Stop gate + heartbeat hooks call the workflow's session-side tools by absolute path. This is a TEMPLATE and is never edited at run time: ferry.sh renders it once per cold spawn into <workspace>/.runtime/profile-<session>.json, substituting {WORKFLOW_ROOT}, {WORKSPACE} and {SESSION_NAME} together — from whichever declaration THAT spawn's own (role, slice) resolution names, so the profile is a pure function of the assignment. launch.sh only checks that the declaration and this file resolve; probe.sh renders its own copy into its per-backend scratch workspace.
